builds.name: The Great Wall
builds.gear_notes: Standard build to boost tankiness via Block Rate and also DMG Taken Reduction. Always aim for the most defensive substats on Rudy to boost his survivability.

builds.name: Maximum Defense
builds.gear_notes: As Rudy has many effects and damage that scales with Defense, this build helps to maximize his potential in all aspects.

builds.name: Healthy Healer
builds.gear_notes: Very viable in Tank-vs-Tank metas to win via having higher HP. Not only that, Rudy now heals so this build can boost his healing amount.

dedicated.name: Rudy's Torn Oath of the Seat of Light

why_by_stat.Resilience: Reduces incoming Critical Damage 1%-for-1%, helping Rudy survive Critical Hits more easily.

dedicated.story:
"I will no longer rely on anything else. I will find my own guiding star through my own will. Kris — I ask only that at least you of all people believe I am right. So that I can press forward in certainty that this is the righteous path."

Rudy once upheld the will of Light as his highest ideal, but after witnessing too many fruitless sacrifices and moments of darkness in that pursuit, he began to harbor deep doubts. Ultimately realizing that the Light was not his true guiding star, he tore up his oath and turned his back on it. Despite the distrust of his companions, Rudy embarked on a journey of independence — declaring his unwavering resolve to rely on no one but himself as he forged a new path of his own making.

lore:
"Rudy, if I do fail... I need you to... end me."

The girl declared she would accept the Power of Destruction... all for the sake of saving one boy. She offered a faint smile, vowing to bring the God of Destruction to heel.

Rudy tried to dissuade her. He knew better than anyone how that path would end. Neither emperors, generals, nor the mightiest of warriors had ever managed to fully harness the Power of Destruction.

Yet here was a girl —so young and frail— insisting she could succeed. She sought neither power nor ambition. Her only wish was to save a single boy. And if she ultimately failed to control it... She pleaded, her voice trembling but her resolve iron-clad, for Rudy to kill her.

Rudy wavered, torn between saving the life of a single girl versus the salvation of the world.
Clutching the Oath of Light, he desperately called upon the Goddess Elena for guidance.

"Please, show me the way..."

But despite Rudy's fervent prayers, the Goddess Elena offered no answer. A cold, hollow void of deep despair began to slowly consume his heart.
Is this truly... the answer I get for my faith...?
In that case, I must...!
